text:
olivia: heads up — our dependency scan picked up CVE-2026-FAKE in glibc for the linux-base image. need a coordinated base-image rebuild + signing + rollout. planning a canary this afternoon.

sec-bot: triage created VULN-2026-FAKE -> severity: high; affected: linux-base:all-arch; suggested action: rebuild & repro-sign images, rotate signing key if used for short-lived keys.

tony: we should treat this as a guarded rollout. cosign signing key currently in awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/fakekey1234 — do we rotate or reuse? rotating is safest but will break any pinned verifiers unless we publish new trusted key.

maria: pipeline: base-image-build job will produce tags: linux-base:2026-03-20-cveFAKE-canary and linux-base:2026-03-20-cveFAKE. canary will hit staging nodes only for 2 hours.

akash: audit question — how long will SBOMs and signing records be retained? compliance needs 1 year of attestations and audit logs for the build signer. current S3 retention is 90 days.

devops: quick permissions note — ephemeral builders (ci-builder-sa) need kms:Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign on the cosign key. currently they have kms:GenerateDataKey but not Sign. will add a role-binding but let's make it scoped to the build namespace.

tony: suggested IAM snippet (short):
```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["kms:Sign","kms:Verify","kms:GetPublicKey"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/fakekey1234"
}
```
apply only to ci-builder role.

akash: also need to ensure CloudTrail/Stackdriver equivalents capture KMS Sign API calls and cosign invocations. link audit logs to central S3 with write-once retention policy.

olivia: proposal: do NOT rotate signing key for the emergency canary (reduce blast radius). Instead:
- build canary with existing key
- push SBOMs and attestations to s3://redwood-audits/cve-2026-fake/ (set 1yr retention)
- schedule key rotation for next week in a controlled window after validation
Is that acceptable?

tony: +1 for reduced churn. we must ensure COSIGN_PUBLIC_KEY (verifier) is updated in internal registries after rotation next week.

maria: canary timeline: start 17:30 UTC, 2h, smoke tests: container-start, small-http-suite, mem/leak scan. If green, roll to staging prod-candidates 03:00 UTC overnight canary to larger fleet.

devops: I'll patch RoleBinding: `kubectl patch rolebinding ci-builder-binding -n infra --type json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/subjects/-","value":{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"ci-builder-sa","namespace":"ci"}}]'` and add kms permissions in IAM.

akash: audit hooks: ensure build pipeline writes a signed envelope: 
`cosign sign --key awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/fakekey1234 registry/repo/linux-base:2026-03-20-cveFAKE-canary`
and store `cosign` output + build logs + sbom in the audit bucket.

sre-oncall: rollback plan: if canary fails, we'll mark the tag deprecated and pin workloads back to linux-base:2026-02-15-stable, add admission controller rule to block the new tag for 1h, and trigger an incident channel. monitor: image-pull errors, OOM, CPU steal, and app error rates. set alert thresholds 3x baseline for 10m.

olivia: lock action items: 
- devops: add kms Sign perms to ci-builder and push patch (ETA 1h) @devops
- maria: kick canary build at 17:30 UTC, publish SBOMs and attestations to s3 path (ETA 17:10) @maria
- tony: verify audit pipeline ingests cosign events and CloudTrail (ETA 30m) @tony
- akash: update compliance ticket with retention ask and notify legal (ETA EOD) @akash
- sre-oncall: prepare dashboard + alerts and standby during canary (ETA start) @sre-oncall

olivia: emergency latch: I'm enabling a temporary branch protection on infra/base-images repo to require two approvals before any merge for the next 24h. no direct pushes. If we see a blocker during canary, I'll flip the emergency freeze and open incident channel. :lock:

maria: noted. will tag images with `canary-by:olivia` in metadata so we can quickly search & revoke.

tony: one more note — when we do the planned rotation next week, add a single-step verifier rollout: publish new public key to internal KMS-trust store, update verifier config, wait 12h, then rotate production signing key. document rollback steps in the signing-runbook.

olivia: thanks all. I'll post a brief runbook summary in #incidents and update the compliance ticket. ping here if you hit permission snags. :thumbsup:
